description: Dependency updates for every pinned version in the repository; see docs/guides/github-settings.md.
Weekly, three days after a release, with Conventional Commit messages (build(deps): ...).
A rebuild of a base image under the same tag comes at once, without the schedule and the wait.
Patch, digest, and pin updates merge themselves when the required check passes; people review minor updates.
A major update gets a pull request only after a person ticks its checkbox on the Dependency Dashboard.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes are proposed at once, outside the weekly schedule.

terraform.description: The providers of every unit are pinned in infra/live/providers.hcl, in the Terraform language. After an update, `make infra-lock` writes the checksums (docs/guides/github-settings.md).

customManagers.description: The lefthook schema that `make check-all` validates lefthook.yml against follows the lefthook version in mise.toml.

packageRules.description: Patch, digest, and pin updates merge themselves once the required check passes.
A major update is a decision, such as the next PostgreSQL: it waits on the Dependency Dashboard until a person asks for its pull request.
One pull request a week for the patch updates of each ecosystem.
The textlint packages are released together.
The go directive of every go.mod moves with the Go in mise.toml; Makefile sets GOTOOLCHAIN=local.
The Go image of backend/Dockerfile moves with the Go version: the build fails when the two differ. A new digest under the same tag changes no version, and is not part of the group.
compose.yaml and db/Dockerfile name the same PostgreSQL image: the database of the local system and the image that prepares the database of an environment move together.
pnpm in mise.toml, packageManager in package.json, and pnpm-lock.yaml name the same version.
The local system (infra/local) and the environments (infra/live/providers.hcl) use the same providers.
lefthook in mise.toml and the schema URL in make/repo.mk name the same version.

A new digest under the same tag is a rebuild of a base image with fixed packages. scan-images fails from the day a package of the image has a fix, so the update comes at once, outside the schedule and without the wait; it merges only when the checks pass.
